unsupported: Leclerc Foods traces its roots to 1905 in Saint-Augustin-de-Desmaures, Quebec, where the Leclerc family began baking cookies.
What started as a small artisanal bakery has grown into a major North American food manufacturer with eight production facilities across Canada and the United States.
Its Food Service division supplies operators with portion-controlled and bulk products, while branded lines such as Célébration, Go Pure, and Tradition 1905 reach consumers through retail.
